CP1.A.1_neuron_reference.notes: Wrapper class supporting AVAL, AIY, RIM, AVAR, custom cells. Self-test reproduces v3-captured AVAL features verbatim (peak_V at +0pA = -39.37 mV, +20pA = +80.62 mV, exact match).

CP1.A.2_voltage_clamp_tolerance.tolerance_metric: max(|a-b| / max(|a|, |b|, 0.1*peak)); per-feature ≤ 5%; per-panel > 80% of holds
CP1.A.2_voltage_clamp_tolerance.notes: Legacy voltage_clamp_compare retained for backward-compat. New v2 entry point with current-domain peak floor.

CP1.A.3_layer_a_compare.tolerance_metric: voltage feature ≤ 3 mV residual at peak + plateau; > 80% of timepoints clear
CP1.A.3_layer_a_compare.notes: Timing features reported as warn-only diagnostics. Smoke-tested on leak-only matched cells: residuals 0.000 mV at peak/plateau, 1.000 fraction passing.

CP1.A.4_smoke_tests.phase_alpha_smoke_regression: all Phase α smoke tests still pass (vc leak match, plateau pass-scaffold pass-as-pass, fail-scaffold pass-as-fail, release-signature distinguishes)

calibration.method: Empirical linear fit Δcai/Δt = α·ica + β·(cai - ca_eq) at AIY-like geometry

CP1.B.5_cadiff_translation.notes: Symbolic re-derivation gave coefficient ~5183 (NMODL hidden unit-conversion factor of ~1e4). Empirical calibration recovers correct value 0.525. Documented in F6/F7/F8 in findings.

calibration.method: Empirical linear fit, ca_eq corrected to 5e-8 (NEURON's raw numerical value of 0.05e-6 (M))
calibration.note: β = -0.020 = -1/50ms = -1/tca, perfect match to formula's intent. Validates caintra1 is purely linear in ica when conditional inactive.

CP1.B.6_caintra1_translation.notes: caintra1 stores cai in private STATE 'caintra' (does NOT write NEURON's cai). Brian2 cai_mM compared against NEURON's mech._ref_caintra. Documented in F1, F5 in findings.

CP1.B.7_combined_capool.configuration: caintra1 driven by EGL-19 ica at AVAL geometry (the configuration CP3 will use)
CP1.B.7_combined_capool.notes: cadiff and caintra1 cannot coexist with both writing cai (NMODL multi-writer); CP3 uses caintra1 only. EGL-19 has no Ca-dependent inactivation (egl19.mod), so caintra1 is bookkeeping in CP3.

issues_surfaced: F1: cadiff WRITES cai but caintra1 does NOT (caintra1 stores private state 'caintra'). Recording must be pool-specific.
F2: NEURON caintra1 produces unphysiologically small Ca peaks (~16 nM from inflated initial states). Upstream behavior; we match it.
F3: cadiff produces dramatic Ca transients (~600 μM peaks). Unphysiological but matches upstream.
F6 (CRITICAL): Symbolic NMODL → Python translation produces ~52,700× error for cadiff due to NMODL's hidden unit-conversion machinery. Empirical calibration is the only reliable path.
F7: Calibration strategy via linear LSQ on Δcai/Δt vs ica + (cai-ca_eq).
F8: Decision — calibrate empirically, document residuals, proceed.
key_decisions: eqs-string encoding for Ca-pool subsystems (option a from harness fitness report).
current-domain analog tolerance metric for voltage-clamp comparison: |a-b|/max(|a|, |b|, 0.1*peak), 5% per-feature, 80% per-panel.
voltage-feature ≤3 mV gate for current-clamp Layer A comparison, 80% of timepoints.
Empirical calibration of Ca-pool coefficients against NEURON (NMODL hidden-unit-factor workaround).
ca_eq for caintra1 = 5e-8 mM (NEURON's raw numerical value of `0.05e-6 (M)`, NOT the unit-converted value).
Internal Brian2 Ca-state unit: mM (matches NEURON's native scale for cadiff and caintra1).
